The Eq29 inverter-density convention mismatch was corrected on 2026-10-14 in NumPy and both MDO consumers: inverter mass now uses output power (motor input). Tests cover the calculated inverter estimate and efficiency invariance. Partial support remains: per-stream drives, default technologies/efficiencies/densities, bus selection and electrical/thermal screens are repository extensions. Case inputs are not universal constants; no experimental/hardware validation follows.
